ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite FLAIR Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_FLAIR.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite FLAIR Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_FLAIR)

Format

A data frame with 7230 observations and 27 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI4, ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI4, ADNI2, ADNI3, ADNI1, ADNIGO

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • PHC_LONIUID numeric LONI Image ID Range value: 35254, ..., 11433158

  • PHC_SCANDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized visit number Range value: 1, ..., 20

  • Imaging_Site numeric Location Site of Imaging Scan Range value: 2, ..., 941

  • PHC_Age_FLAIR numeric Age at each FLAIR visit Range value: 50.5325119780972, ..., 97.45106091718

  • FieldStrength numeric Strength of the magnetic field used in the MRI scanner, measured in Tesla. Range value: 1.5, ..., 3

  • Manufacturer character Manufacturer of the MRI scanner , with options: Siemens Healthineers, SIEMENS, Philips, GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS, Philips Medical Systems, Philips Healthcare, Siemens

  • Model character The specific model name of the MRI scanner, usually provided by the manufacturer.

  • Image_Dimensions_vox character Dimensions of the acquired FLAIR image

  • SliceThickness numeric Thickness of each individual slice or section in the FLAIR image, measured in millimeters Range value: 0.999145, ..., 15.000004

  • EchoTime numeric Time between the center of the excitation pulse and the center of the echo, measured in milliseconds. Range value: 0.000101923, ..., 0.445

  • RepetitionTime numeric Time between successive MRI pulse sequences, measured in milliseconds. Range value: 0, ..., 12

  • FlipAngle numeric Angle between the net magnetization vector and the magnetic field, usually determined by the MRI pulse sequence. Range value: 9, ..., 180

  • CNR_WM numeric Contrast-to-noise ratio for total white matter Range value: 2.762, ..., 4.706

  • SNR_WM numeric Signal-to-noise ratio for total white matter Range value: 2.848, ..., 4.964

  • CNR_GM numeric Contrast-to-noise ratio for total gray matter Range value: 2.663, ..., 4.522

  • SNR_GM numeric Signal-to-noise ratio for total gray matter Range value: 2.998, ..., 4.814

  • Contrast_WM_GM numeric Measure of the contrast difference between white matter and gray matter in the MRI scan. Range value: 0, ..., 1.623

  • PHC_WMHVOL_Harmonized numeric Total volume of white matter hyperintensities (WMH) in the brain, measured in cubic centimeters harmonized across studies using standard Combat method Range value: 0.00095041499869275, ..., 137.042170176941

  • update_stamp POSIXct: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
